stories.headline: Indian crude basket tops $100 per barrel again
stories.summary: The Indian crude oil basket crossed $100 per barrel for the first time in months, hitting $101.07 on September 4, as renewed US-Iran tensions in West Asia raise concerns over India's oil import bill. Rising crude could push marketing margins on auto fuels negative and force LPG under-recoveries higher, raising the current account deficit and worsening India's balance of payments.

stories.headline: States' capex utilisation climbed to 3-year high in April-July
stories.summary: Capex by 22 states in April-July FY27 rose to a three-year high, with states utilising 16.11 per cent of budgeted capex against 15.77 per cent in FY26, per CAG data. Kerala led with 42.36 per cent of its budgeted capex spent, followed by Himachal Pradesh (27.07 per cent) and Punjab (23.39 per cent); Odisha (12.04 per cent) and Uttar Pradesh (10.15 per cent) were the weakest performers.

stories.headline: India Inc's biz confidence in Q2 highest in 3 qtrs
stories.summary: The CII Business Confidence Index rose to a three-year high of 66.0 in July-September (Q2FY27), driven by easing geopolitical disruptions and resilient domestic demand. The Expectation Index jumped to 67.7 in Q2FY27 from 60.6, while over 40 per cent of respondents expect demand growth of more than 20 per cent next quarter.

stories.headline: BoB ups FY27 GDP forecast on strong Q1
stories.summary: Bank of Baroda raised its FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7-7.2 per cent from 6.6-6.8 per cent after Q1FY27 GDP grew 7.8 per cent year-on-year, aided by strong private consumption and government spending.

stories.headline: Work demand under VB G RAM G sees recovery in August
stories.summary: Rural work demand under the newly launched VB GRAM G (Viksit Bharat Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission-Grameen), which replaced MGNREGA from July 1, rose 4.4 per cent year-on-year in August to 12.4 million households, after a nearly 40 per cent drop in July versus last year.

stories.headline: FY26 incentive scheme for PSB staff kept on hold
stories.summary: The government has kept the performance-linked incentive (PLI) scheme for public-sector bank employees for 2025-26 in abeyance following a review request from unions, amid a nationwide bank strike call by UFBU for September 11 over PLI and other demands.

stories.headline: Corrective supply steps on to tackle stock situation: CoalMin
stories.summary: The Ministry of Coal said corrective supply measures are underway to address critical coal stock situations at thermal power plants, after rake loading to the power sector rose steadily to 444 rakes per day on Sunday from 370 earlier in the week, and critical stock plants fell to 45 from 58 at the start of September.

stories.headline: Coal gasification scheme set for first industry test
stories.summary: The Ministry of Coal opened applications on September 8 under its ₹37,500 crore financial incentive scheme for surface coal and lignite gasification, following approval by the Union Cabinet in May. The scheme aims to catalyse up to ₹3 trillion of investment, generate 50,000 jobs, and help India reach its 100 million tonne coal gasification capacity target by 2030.

stories.headline: Universal pension scheme: Labour ministry eyes flexible payouts
stories.summary: The labour ministry is working on a universal pension scheme under EPFO that would let subscribers opt for higher payouts early in retirement and reduce them later, introducing a 'Target Retirement Sum' concept. The new scheme would operate alongside the existing EPS and is being developed as part of the broader EPFO 3.0 reforms.

stories.headline: Govt set to review export promotion schemes
stories.summary: The government is reviewing export promotion schemes such as credit assistance for e-commerce exporters and the ECLGS-linked collateral-free credit scheme after the latter drew limited interest, with the finance ministry and commerce ministry looking to make the schemes more usable by SMEs and exporters.

stories.headline: Govt gives initial nod for ₹1.1 trn defence acquisitions
stories.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council under Rajnath Singh accorded 'Acceptance of Necessity' to proposed defence purchases worth ₹1.1 trillion for the Army, Navy and Air Force, including reconnaissance vehicles, Arudhra radars, Advanced Light Helicopters and a marine gas turbine propulsion system, aimed at reducing import dependency.

stories.headline: Sebi eases investor group disclosure for FPIs investing in govt bonds
stories.summary: Sebi exempted foreign portfolio investors investing exclusively in government securities from furnishing investor group details, extending a September 2025 relaxation for FPIs in the fully accessible route to those in the general route as well.

stories.headline: VWAP-based settlements for index derivatives may be among Sebi's CAS fixes: HDFC Securities
stories.summary: Sebi's proposed changes to the closing auction session (CAS) for setting derivative settlement prices may include volume-weighted average price (VWAP) based settlement, tighter auction price bands and an overlapping auction window, according to a report by HDFC Securities.

stories.headline: Senior vacancies at AAI pose safety risk: Union
stories.summary: The Air Traffic Controllers' Guild (India) told the civil aviation ministry that vacancies in two senior leadership positions in the Airports Authority of India's air traffic management division pose a direct risk to safety oversight and system resilience, urging immediate relaxation of promotion rules.

stories.headline: L&T-L&T Realty Properties company scheme petition admitted for hearing at NCLT Mumbai
stories.summary: [[Larsen & Toubro Limited]] and [[L&T Realty Properties Limited]] filed a company scheme petition under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013 before the NCLT Mumbai bench, seeking sanction of a scheme of arrangement transferring the Realty Undertaking; the petition is fixed for hearing on September 6, 2026.

stories.headline: Coastal Local Area Bank granted 'Scheduled Bank Status' by RBI
stories.summary: [[Coastal Local Area Bank]], which has provided banking services from Vijayawada for 26 years, was included in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934, attaining scheduled commercial bank status following an RBI notification dated September 4, 2026.

stories.headline: Companies file AGM notices and e-voting information for FY2025-26
stories.summary: Numerous listed companies published statutory AGM notices, book-closure dates and remote e-voting schedules for their financial year 2025-26 annual general meetings, including [[Global Defence Industries]], [[Organic Recycling Systems]], [[InCred Holdings]], [[Panacea Biotec]], [[Infronics Systems]], [[Shipwaves Online]], [[Netlink Solutions (India)]], [[MPS Infotecnics]], [[Zelio E-Mobility]], [[Concord Control Systems]], [[Kothari Products]], [[W.S. Industries (India)]], [[Bharati Defence and Infrastructure]], [[Technvision Ventures]], [[ProYuga Advanced Technologies]], [[Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation]], [[Apollo Sindoori Hotels]], [[Intrasoft Technologies]], [[Zodiac Clothing Company]], [[Jaykay Enterprises]], [[Jagatjit Industries]], [[ANG Lifesciences India]], [[Gallantt Ispat]], [[Gajanan Securities Services]], [[Party Cruisers]], [[Atcom Technologies]], [[Welterman International]], [[Amforge Industries]], [[Garodia Chemicals]], [[Syncom Formulations (India)]], [[Ganesh Benzoplast]], [[Retaggio Industries]], [[Colab Platforms]], [[Avatar Industries]], [[3B Blackbio DX]], [[Mallcom (India)]], [[ATN International]], [[Mount Housing and Infrastructure]], [[Prime Focus]], [[JK Urbanscapes Developers]], [[Nibe]], [[Pioneer Investcorp]], [[Tierra Agrotech]], [[Harish Textile Engineers]], [[Emami Realty]], [[Salasar Techno Engineering]], [[Azad Engineering]], [[Dish TV India]], [[Haleos Labs]], [[Vaarad Ventures]], [[Onix Solar Energy]], [[Silicon Valley Infotech]], [[Visdem Technosys]], [[CMS Finvest]], and [[KN Agri Resources]].

stories.headline: Companies issue share-transfer, IEPF and dematerialisation special-window notices
stories.summary: [[Morarka Finance]] and [[Lambodhara Textiles]] opened special windows for transfer/dematerialisation of physical shares; [[Exide Industries]] and [[Emami Limited]] issued notices for transfer of unclaimed dividend/equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund; and [[Hero MotoCorp]] opened a special window for dematerialisation of physical shares.

stories.headline: Companies issue lost share-certificate public notices
stories.summary: Public notices were issued for lost share certificates relating to shares in [[Hindustan Unilever]] (in the name of Rajesh Gupta), [[The Phoenix Mills]] (in the name of the late Pandit Ambalal Chhaganlal), [[State Bank of India]] (in the name of Rajesh Maheshwari), and a property held via [[Visdem Technosys]]-linked registrar records (Rupesh Sharad Shete).

stories.headline: Alchemist Asset Reconstruction Company issues SARFAESI possession notice
stories.summary: [[Alchemist Asset Reconstruction Company]], as trustee of Alchemist XLVII Trust, issued a possession notice under the SARFAESI Act against secured assets of Mukesh Babulnath Bhatre and Mrs Jaibai Babulnath Bhatre.

stories.headline: EBAHETI Solutions Private Limited seeks confirmation to shift registered office to Rajasthan
stories.summary: [[EBAHETI Solutions Private Limited]] filed a petition before the Central Government to shift its registered office from Maharashtra to Rajasthan under Section 13 of the Companies Act, 2013.

stories.headline: Metal Closures Pvt Ltd (in liquidation) issues e-auction sale notice
stories.summary: The liquidator of [[Metal Closures Pvt Ltd]], under insolvency proceedings, issued an e-auction sale notice for land, buildings, plant and machinery and other assets at its Bengaluru facility, with e-auctions scheduled for October 8-10, 2026.

stories.headline: NBFCs' gold loans rise; banks see slower growth
stories.summary: Gold loans were the fastest-growing retail loan category for NBFCs, up 68.5 per cent year-on-year in July, versus 4 per cent growth in gold-backed loans at banks. Overall NBFC credit grew 14.9 per cent y-o-y in July to ₹59.89 trillion, outpacing 10.6 per cent growth at banks.

stories.headline: Alternative fuels zoom past petrol in share of PV sales
stories.summary: CNG, hybrid and electric vehicles together overtook petrol in the passenger-vehicle mix in August 2025, with alternative fuels' combined share rising to 41.95 per cent versus petrol's 40.85 per cent, per Fada data; auto retail sales hit a record August at 4,02,398 units, up 16.14 per cent year-on-year.

stories.headline: Hungry, thirsty and raring to go: data centres bat for air-cooled systems amid India's water woes
stories.summary: India's data-centre boom, expected to more than double capacity to 358 billion litres of water use by 2030, is drawing scrutiny over water and power demand in cities like Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad. Industry executives say air-cooled chiller systems and closed-loop cooling can cut water consumption sharply even as AI-driven power demand is expected to rise 5 per cent of peak capacity by 2030.

stories.headline: ER&D firms need new playbook: Nasscom's Patil
stories.summary: Nasscom Vice-Chairperson Kishor Patil said Indian engineering research and development (ER&D) firms, expected to touch $100 billion by the end of the decade from $63 billion in 2026, need to shift from cost-based to outcome-based, annual-recurring-revenue models to avoid being squeezed by AI-driven spend cuts on old-tech maintenance.

stories.headline: Blackstone weighs stake buy in IIFL Finance
stories.summary: [[Blackstone]] is among global private equity firms weighing a stake purchase in mid-sized shadow lender [[IIFL Finance]], as [[Fairfax Financial Holdings]] looks to exit some or all of its 15.2 per cent stake, valued at about $6.2 billion at current prices, sources said. Fairfax and IIFL Finance did not respond to requests for comment; Blackstone declined to respond.

stories.headline: Bank of America works on Zelle-UPI bridge for cross-border payments
stories.summary: In an interview, [[Bank of America]]'s global head of transactional FX and cross-border payments Daniel Stanton said BofA is piloting a link between Zelle in the US and India's UPI as part of its push into real-time payment (RTP) rails, calling India one of the most compelling markets in the cross-border payments shift.

stories.headline: SBI, BoB caution against disruptions from unions' strike calls
stories.summary: [[State Bank of India]] and [[Bank of Baroda]] cautioned that banking operations could be affected by a series of strikes called by the United Forum of Bank Unions on September 11, 28, 29, 30 and an indefinite strike from October 26, over demands including reversal of the performance-linked incentive scheme.

stories.headline: Swiggy launches 24x7 customer support, helpline
stories.summary: [[Swiggy]] launched a round-the-clock customer helpline and a dedicated 'Food Safety' channel in its app's Help section, amid heightened scrutiny by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India on food delivery platforms.

stories.headline: Gaja Capital's next bet: India's AI stack
stories.summary: [[Gaja Capital]], traditionally a mid-market PE investor, has placed bets on AI at both ends of India's stack — investing in [[Fractal Analytics]] and taking a secondary stake in language-model startup [[Sarvam AI]] at a $1.44 billion valuation in July 2025 — as it looks to build deep domain expertise in AI-first software services.

stories.headline: HUL stocks up for its next growth cycle
stories.summary: [[Hindustan Unilever]]'s premiumisation-led growth strategy for FY26-27 and beyond, focused on 'New India' consumption cohorts, digital penetration and category expansion, is winning brokerage confidence even as valuations stay largely flat; brokerages including Jefferies and JM Financial have retained or raised 'buy' ratings with higher target multiples.

stories.headline: RBL Bank okays $1 bn EMTN programme
stories.summary: [[RBL Bank]]'s board approved a plan to establish a $1 billion Euro Medium Term Note programme, giving the private lender a framework to raise funds through foreign-currency bonds, notes or other debt securities in overseas markets, with issuance flexible in tenor and currency subject to market conditions.

stories.headline: LIC's new business premium rose 33.07% in August
stories.summary: [[Life Insurance Corporation of India]]'s new business premium rose 33.07 per cent year-on-year in August to ₹41,197.78 crore, improving from 20 per cent growth in July, driven by robust premium mobilisation by both state-owned LIC and private insurers; Bajaj Life Insurance posted the strongest growth at nearly 31.6 per cent.

stories.headline: Udaan buys Swiggy's LYNK for ₹500 crore
stories.summary: IPO-bound B2B ecommerce firm [[Udaan]] acquired [[Swiggy]]'s wholly-owned tech-driven retail distribution platform LYNK Logistics for ₹500 crore, settled via issue of preference equity shares to [[Swiggy]] in [[Trustroot Internet]] (Udaan's parent), giving [[Swiggy]] a 2.8 per cent stake in Udaan. It is Udaan's second major acquisition after ShopKirana.

stories.headline: GalaxEye first Indian startup to win US patent for imaging tech
stories.summary: [[GalaxEye]], an Indian space-tech startup building next-generation Earth-observation satellites, announced it has been granted a US patent for its core OptoSAR imaging technology, making it the first Indian startup to receive a US patent for satellite imaging technology.

stories.headline: Agnikul opens two units, scales infra for reusable rockets
stories.summary: Space startup [[Agnikul Cosmos]] inaugurated two new units at its assembly and testing facility in Chennai, expanding its capability to test rocket stages under flight-like conditions and manufacture critical launch-vehicle components in-house, as part of its Mission-02/PROOF programme.

stories.headline: Purple Style Labs makes muted market debut; shares end over 1% lower
stories.summary: [[Purple Style Labs]] closed its maiden trading session at ₹568.05, down 1.21 per cent from its ₹575 issue price, after opening at a 6.26 per cent discount on the BSE. The stock touched an intraday high of ₹588.10 before settling; the IPO was subscribed 1.36 times.

stories.headline: Steamhouse India, Manika Plastech price IPOs under ₹100/share
stories.summary: [[Steamhouse India]]'s ₹77-81/share IPO opens September 9 and closes September 11, comprising a ₹353 crore fresh issue and an offer for sale of ₹61 crore. [[Manika Plastech]]'s ₹40-43/share, approximately ₹125 crore IPO opens September 11 and closes September 16, comprising a fresh issue of ₹92 crore and an offer for sale of 7.7 million shares.

stories.headline: Pranav Constructions IPO subscribed 5.69x on Day 1 of bidding
stories.summary: The ₹351 crore IPO of real estate developer [[Pranav Constructions]] was subscribed 5.69 times on its first day of bidding, receiving bids for 12,78,82,920 shares against 2,24,63,137 shares on offer; the non-institutional investor category was subscribed 10.60 times.

stories.headline: Fly-Hi Maritime Travels Limited completes basis of allotment; SME IPO lists today
stories.summary: [[Fly-Hi Maritime Travels Limited]]'s SME IPO of up to 51,60,000 equity shares at a fixed price of ₹102 each, comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale by promoter Jitendra Kumar Negi, was subscribed 2.10 times; the Basis of Allotment was finalised on September 4, with trading proposed to commence on the BSE SME platform on September 8, 2026.

stories.headline: Banks show little appetite for RBI's 30-day VRRR bid
stories.summary: The RBI received tepid demand at its 30-day variable rate reverse repo auction on Monday, drawing bids worth ₹2.59 trillion against the ₹7 trillion notified amount, as banks remained reluctant to park funds long-term amid upcoming GST and advance-tax outflows. Net liquidity surplus stood at a record ₹11.16 trillion on Sunday.

stories.headline: India Inc's intent to raise foreign funds hit $7.7 bn in Jul
stories.summary: Indian companies, including NBFCs, filed proposals with the RBI to raise $7.7 billion via external commercial borrowings and foreign currency convertible bonds in July, up from $6.09 billion in June, led by [[Flipkart Internet]]'s plan to raise $712 million and [[RRP Electronics]]'s plan to raise $650 million.

stories.headline: Tech stocks buckle under rising oil prices, geopolitical pressure
stories.summary: A selloff in IT stocks led by [[Infosys]] dragged the Nifty to its lowest close in nearly two months, as investors turned cautious on West Asia tensions, crude prices and two large upcoming IPOs (Reliance Jio and NSE) that could suck liquidity from secondary markets. The Nifty IT index fell 2.28 per cent; Infosys dropped 3.76 per cent to ₹1,087.5.

stories.headline: Financial stocks attracted a third of FPI haul in Aug
stories.summary: Financial stocks drew ₹10,494 crore of the ₹29,628 crore foreign portfolio investment inflow into Indian equities in August, followed by consumer services (₹8,417 crore) and healthcare (₹5,931 crore), even as telecom saw the sharpest FPI outflows of ₹4,983 crore.

stories.headline: Fund houses place heavy bets on fresh offerings
stories.summary: Indian mutual funds are placing high-conviction bets on newly listed companies such as [[Shadowfax Technologies]] and [[Amagi Media]], with [[ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund]] and [[SBI Mutual Fund]] emerging as the top allocators; ICICI Prudential holds a 6.95 per cent stake in Shadowfax worth ₹1,019.6 crore.

stories.headline: Space, steel, fintech at heart of Luxembourg's India push: Lex Delles
stories.summary: Luxembourg Economy Minister Lex Delles said space, green steel and financial technology are key areas for expanded India-Luxembourg cooperation, as bilateral trade of $145.9 million in 2024-25 is set to get a boost from the proposed India-EU free trade agreement.

stories.headline: India, US to join hands on Moon Base, space economy
stories.summary: The US invited Indian startups to explore opportunities in the American market and India's Isro to join the Moon Base programme, US Ambassador Sergio Gor announced at Bengaluru Space Expo 2026; Isro is targeting six missions this year including the first uncrewed Gaganyaan flight.

stories.headline: German far-right AfD wins first state poll since WWII
stories.summary: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) surged into first place in Saxony-Anhalt state elections, winning 44 per cent of the vote and putting the far-right party within reach of power at the state level for the first time since World War Two, dealing a setback to Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives.

stories.headline: US energy firms' facilities are 'exposed' to hits: Iran
stories.summary: Iran threatened to retaliate against any new US attacks on its assets, warning that regional energy infrastructure was 'sprawling, accessible and exposed,' after Tehran hit a Saudi Aramco-linked facility and vowed further retaliation if its oil sites are attacked amid the ongoing US-Israel-Iran conflict.

stories.headline: India-China military talks prompted by mix of factors
stories.summary: High-ranking military officials from India and China met to discuss the eastern sector of the Line of Actual Control, ahead of the expected visit of Chinese President Xi Jinping to India for the BRICS summit, amid heightened tension in the western and middle sectors of the border.

stories.headline: Five killed in Amazon cargo plane crash
stories.summary: At least five people died when an Amazon Prime Air cargo flight, Prime Air Flight 7598, overran a runway and crashed at Miami International Airport, striking multiple vehicles on the ground; five people were injured and two remain critically trapped.

stories.headline: Israeli airstrikes on Lebanese village kill 12
stories.summary: Israel's air force carried out two airstrikes on a southern Lebanese village, killing at least 12 people including children, amid a new round of escalation between Israel and Hezbollah despite a truce reached over two months ago.

stories.headline: Not ruling out 3-way peace talks: Moscow
stories.summary: The Kremlin said it did not rule out a resumption of trilateral peace talks between Russia, Ukraine and the US, following talks between Russian envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy that yielded no breakthrough.

stories.headline: AI could pose 'existential' risk to humanity, UN rights chief warns
stories.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Turk warned that artificial intelligence could pose a threat to humanity and called for AI firms to reduce risks including disruptions to services, communications and democratic systems.

stories.headline: Nepal holds day of mourning on 13th day of flood tragedy
stories.summary: Nepal observed a national day of mourning on the 13th day of the Rasuwa flash flood disaster that killed more than 1,356 people, with nearly 5,000 remaining missing after an ice-rock avalanche in the high Himalayas on August 26.

stories.headline: N Korea adds 2nd destroyer into service
stories.summary: North Korea commissioned its second naval destroyer as leader Kim Jong Un pushes for a more reliable nuclear deterrent, amid a trilateral US-South Korea-Japan military exercise.

stories.headline: Ohio governor candidate attacked at fair, unharmed
stories.summary: Democratic Ohio gubernatorial nominee Amy Acton was attacked by an armed individual at the Canfield Fair, but was unharmed; the suspect was charged with disorderly conduct and two counts of assault.

stories.headline: OpenAI chief scientist says no one ready for AI's rapid rise
stories.summary: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warned of an accelerating pace of AI progress and said 'no one is prepared' for the consequences of rapidly rising machine intelligence, calling for voluntary slowdowns until comparable safety bars are established.

stories.headline: Delhi building collapse: Death toll reaches 7; owner arrested
stories.summary: The death toll from the Satya Sadan building collapse in Delhi rose to seven, with the building owner and his son arrested and five MCD officials suspended after a preliminary probe found waterlogging, poor construction and unauthorised building additions responsible.

stories.headline: Nearly 50% of India's rape cases in last 50 yrs reported post-Nirbhaya
stories.summary: A recent rape case in Delhi has revived memories of the 2012 Nirbhaya case; NCRB data shows 47.2 per cent of all rape cases recorded between 1971 and 2025 came after 2012, with reported cases pending in courts rising to 89.8 per cent by 2024 even as conviction rates fell to 24.4 per cent.

stories.headline: Only 23% rural households in India use LPG exclusively: Study
stories.summary: A CEEW study found only 23 per cent of rural households in India use LPG exclusively, with 47 per cent of LPG users still relying on firewood as their primary fuel, citing refill cost and last-mile logistics as key barriers to clean cooking transition.

stories.headline: Novo's Wegovy reversed childhood obesity: Study
stories.summary: A study found [[Novo Nordisk]]'s obesity drug Wegovy helped a majority of five children lose enough weight to no longer be classified as obese, marking the first look at its effect on young children; about 40 per cent of trial children given Wegovy were no longer obese after about a year.

stories.headline: An AI-generated lung medicine may also 'cure' ageing, trial shows
stories.summary: A clinical trial by [[Insilico Medicine]] found that rentosertib, an AI-designed drug for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, also reduced patients' predicted biological age as measured by six 'ageing clocks' over 12 weeks of treatment, though experts caution the sample size was small.

stories.headline: Rules for growth: India needs fewer and simpler regulations
stories.summary: Editorial arguing that the IMF's new G20 report on growth, which estimates medium-term G20 growth at just 3 per cent, points to overly restrictive regulations on labour, product and consumer markets as major barriers to investment, and calls for India to prioritise clearer, simpler rules over piecemeal deregulation.

stories.headline: All fall down: Ill-financed municipalities are endangering citizens
stories.summary: Editorial on Delhi's spate of fatal building collapses, arguing that derelict municipal administration and malfeasance — not just unauthorised construction — are root causes, and that municipal reform to fund cities properly is an urgent priority.

stories.headline: What is a personal guarantee really worth?
stories.summary: Opinion column by M S Sahoo and Raghav Pandey arguing that a personal guarantee's value should be assessed against the guarantor's realisable net worth and the counterfactual recovery under available alternatives, not merely against the face value of the underlying corporate debt.

stories.headline: Media's post-liberalisation report card
stories.summary: Mediascope column by Vanita Kohli-Khandekar noting India's media and entertainment business, at about ₹2,000 crore in 1991, has grown to roughly ₹2,000 crore… now nearly $32 billion in revenue but remains abysmally small relative to China's, held back by ad-hoc regulation, dodgy capital in the IT boom era, and a decade-long delay in scaling to global size.

stories.headline: 'Fruits of reforms are often reaped by later governments': Shankar Acharya
stories.summary: In an interview marking 35 years of liberalisation, former Chief Economic Adviser Shankar Acharya said India's 1991 reforms took time to fructify, with later governments often reaping the benefits, and cautioned that India's current low-single-digit non-agricultural employment growth remains a weak point despite average 6.5 per cent GDP growth since 1991.

stories.headline: Volume gains, diversification to drive revenue growth for NMDC
stories.summary: Analyst column (The Compass) noting [[NMDC]]'s iron ore volume growth and diversification into coal, rare earths and other critical minerals is expected to translate into 6 per cent annual production growth and Ebitda margin expansion to 35-40 per cent over the medium term, though global commodity pricing weakness is a risk.
